capabilities: Ask questions across selected vault folders
Cite the note, heading, PDF page or web URL behind each answer
Index Markdown, TXT, PDF, EPUB, FB2 and DOCX files
Answer with local models through Ollama or LM Studio, or a cloud API
Save an answer as a new note or append it to the active note
extras: Web search is opt-in and off until the Web or Index + Web scope is chosen. Mobile requires a cloud endpoint; local loopback servers are unavailable there. No OCR, so scanned PDFs without a text layer contribute nothing. A tool-enabled model may create, update or delete notes, so a read-only profile is advised.
problem: Finding the note or page that holds an answer means searching and reading many files, and a generated answer gives no way to see which source supports it.

relations.evidence: use a local model through Ollama or LM Studio
LM Studio or another OpenAI-compatible server
optionally search the web through DuckDuckGo or another configured source

summary: Chat plugin that answers questions from selected vault folders and optional web search, linking each answer to its source note, heading, PDF page, or URL.
